svg.title: Serving tags
svg.desc: The lag tag reads capture files and uses only complete flows, so its state is about 150 s behind the wire. The live tag reads the detection stream, every flow 10 ms after its first packet, with a compressor and world model trained on the detection encoder's output, and is a few seconds behind. serving.json names each tag's models; resolve refuses a tag whose models are not trained. The table gives, for each attack, how often its next new target is still ahead when each tag serves.
